evidence.observation: Tube pressure has climbed monotonically through growth from ~3.02 to 3.51 Torr while setpoints are unchanged
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control looks fine
O2 sensor not installed, so atmosphere integrity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a flow-step test: briefly cut Ar and watch whether pressure decays promptly) would distinguish an air/seal leak from a downstream exhaust restriction.
